name: 1-ethoxy-2-propanol
description: 1-Ethoxy-2-propanol (CAS 1569-02-4 ), commercially known as propylene glycol ethyl ether or PGEE, is a glycol ether solvent used across coatings, personal care, and pharmaceutical manufacturing. It delivers controlled evaporation rates and broad solubility, making it a practical choice for formulations requiring compatibility with both polar and non-polar systems. In industrial and architectural coatings, it functions as a coalescing solvent. This chemical improves film formation and flow in waterborne and solvent-based systems. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers use it to adjust viscosity and open time in reactive and pressure-sensitive formulations. Personal care producers incorporate it into lotions, gels, and sprays as a solvent-carrier for active ingredients and fragrance components. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it supports the processing of topical formulations. Low toxicity and skin compatibility are procurement priorities for these specialized applications. 1-Ethoxy-2-propanol is supplied as a clear liquid in standard packaging including drums and IBCs. Bulk quantities are available for industrial buyers. Technical grade is the most common commercial specification, with high-purity grades available for pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications. Buyers should confirm purity levels and water content specifications when sourcing for sensitive formulations.
